verdict.rationale: Outposts lets you run Devin sessions inside infrastructure you control, such as your own VMs, containers, Kubernetes clusters or a Mac Mini. The local CLI is also described as having deep Devin Cloud integration, so the evidence only shows session execution moving onto your hardware, not the whole product running independently. Missing for 10: evidence that the control plane and orchestration can be self-hosted, air-gapped or offline operation, self-hosted model support, deployment documentation beyond the overview, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Outposts.
